facts.fact: Africa50 (a pan-African infrastructure investor) co-led a USD 14 million Series A.5 equity round into Zeepay Ghana Ltd, a Ghana-incorporated mobile-money remittance settlement company, with Oikocredit putting in USD 5 million and Injaro Ghana Venture Capital Fund, Verdant Capital Hybrid Fund and Investisseurs & Partenaires also investing; the round closed in April 2024 and Africa50's own ticket is imputed, not disclosed.
facts.system: Zeepay Ghana Series A.5 equity round
